connector.name: Mdmagic MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Use your own Word templates to convert Markdown → DOCX/PDF/HTML from any MCP-compatible AI.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.mdmagic.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mdmagic-mcp account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Your personal MDMagic API key from https://mdmagic.ai/account

env.name: MDMAGIC_API_KEY
env.description: Your personal MDMagic API key (format: mdmagic-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX). Get yours at https://mdmagic.ai/account — the 'Connect to AI Assistants via MCP' card on your account page generates the key and pre-fills a copy-pasteable config block.

env.name: MDMAGIC_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the MDMagic API base URL. Defaults to https://api.mdmagic.ai. Only set this if you're running MDMagic against a local dev backend.

env.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT
env.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Increase for very large documents on slow connections. Default: 30000 (30s).

env.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Transport mode: 'stdio' (default, for local clients like Claude Desktop) or 'http' (for self-hosted Streamable HTTP).

env.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
env.description: Port for HTTP transport mode. Default: 3001. Only used when MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

env.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
env.description: Bind address for HTTP transport mode. Default: 127.0.0.1. Only used when MCP_TRANSPORT=http.
